headline: US Sanctions Law Firm, Shipping Agents and Nine Vessels Over Iran Oil
summary: The US imposed sanctions on a law firm, shipping agents, and nine vessels accused of helping Iran transport oil and commodities internationally.
why: US sanctions enforce petroleum export restrictions against Iran, altering maritime shipping routes and illicit oil flows.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Enforcement actions against shadow fleet vessels risk restricting unauthorized crude oil supplies on global markets.
